name: Paspahegh
description: The nearest town, whose land the fort was built on without asking. They deal with the colony because it is close, not because they welcome it.

name: Quiyoughcohanock
description: Across the river and a little downstream. Willing traders in a good year, and the first to close their granaries in a bad one.

name: Werowocomoco
description: Wahunsenacawh's own town, seat of an alliance of some thirty tribes. The richest granaries on the river, and the most to lose by giving them away.
